tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind content: the page on phone, the area around panels on laptop.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Lists, panels, the timetable grid, inputs. Free timetable slots are plain surface: that is what makes them read as free.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: segmented-control track, cancelled lesson blocks, neutral badges, notices.

tokens.name: surface-float
tokens.usage: Things that float: menus, sheets, dialogs, popovers. Always with shadow-float or shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and timetable grid lines. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundaries of controls (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes). 3:1 or better on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-sunken, surface-float, ink-subtle and every *-subtle tint.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text (locations, counts, hints) on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and surface-float.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Least important text: timestamps, hour labels, placeholders, cancelled lessons. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The working colour: primary buttons, the active navigation item's icon, selected states.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Scheduled lesson blocks, selected rows, active navigation background, avatars.

tokens.name: ink-subtle-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge of a scheduled lesson block so blocks stay distinct on the grid.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The penny. Only for now and today: the current-time line, today's date marker, and the brand mark. Never for buttons, links or status.

tokens.name: copper-text
tokens.usage: Copper words: the current-time label and today's date. On surface, canvas and copper-subtle.

tokens.name: copper-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of today's column header and today's date in pickers.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed lessons and paid requests, always with a check icon and a word. Text on surface and success-subtle.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of completed lesson blocks and paid badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: No-shows and payments due soon, always with an icon and a word. Text on surface and warning-subtle.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of no-show blocks and warning notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Clashes, overdue payments, destructive actions, field errors, always with an icon and a word. Text on surface and danger-subtle.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of clash badges, overdue badges and error notices.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the date on Today, the screen title on laptop.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles on phone, sheet and dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring the scale book next week.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Badges, field labels, segmented control labels, names inside lesson blocks.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timetable hour labels, timestamps, bottom navigation labels.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Lesson times in rows. Always tabular figures (font-feature tnum).

styles.name: time-lg
styles.usage: The time spine on Today. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Money. Tabular figures, currency prefix, two decimals.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Use these steps only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges; gap between stacked avatars' rings.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons; inner padding of lesson blocks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input side padding; gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins on phone; row padding; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; panel padding on laptop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen side margins on laptop; gap before a screen's first section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Largest gap; separates unrelated blocks on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Lesson blocks, segmented-control segments, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, navigation items, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels on laptop, snackbars, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs; top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the now-line dot. Nothing else is fully round.

shadow.note: Only things that float get a shadow. Lists, rows, panels and lesson blocks are flat.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, snackbars.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs, above scrim.

size.note: Fixed dimensions shared by several components.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tap area for anything interactive, even when the visual is smaller.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Inputs and standard buttons.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and segmented control on laptop only.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Phone bottom navigation, plus the device safe area.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Laptop sidebar.

tokens.name: timetable-hour
tokens.usage: Height of one hour in day and week timetables (16px per 15 minutes).

tokens.name: timetable-gutter
tokens.usage: Width of the hour-label column.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of list and form content on wide screens. The timetable is not capped.
